## Flyto2 Core: Arbitrary file write via unguarded data.*/file.* modules (incomplete fix of CVE-2026-67429)

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p34x-fmph-9fjx).

CVE-2026-77312 (official CVSS 10): Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. Prior to 2.26.8, the earlier CVE-2026-67429 remediation applied validate_path_with_env_config() to only a hand-picked set of file-writing modules, leaving data.csv.write in src/core/modules/atomic/data/csv_write.py, data.json_to_csv in src/core/modules/atomic/data/json_to_csv.py, file.copy in src/core/modules/atomic/file/copy.py, and file.move in src/core/modules/atomic/file/move.py outside the FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR confinement boundary.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: flyto-core 2.26.8.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-77312 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77312) |
| CVSS 10 | official | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77312) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

SecOpsAI detection: `secopsai supply-chain advisory-check --advisory GHSA-p34x-fmph-9fjx PATH` flags flyto-core before 2.26.8 in a project's manifests and lockfiles.

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

Published 20 Nov 2026, 00:09 UTC; first seen by SecOpsAI 20 Nov 2026, 00:17 UTC.

## Etherpad: Pre-auth arbitrary file read

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mc8w-wjhw-45x5).

CVE-2026-114516 (official CVSS 9.8): On POSIX systems the sanitizer correctly treats backslashes as ordinary filename bytes, but the later conversion turns encoded backslash-separated parent-directory segments into traversal components without revalidation or containment. The expressPreSession registration and the always-present ep_etherpad-lite core pseudo-plugin make this path reachable without credentials, allowing a remote attacker to read any file available to the Etherpad process.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: ep_etherpad-lite 3.3.3.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-114516 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-114516) |

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

## NLTK incomplete fix: additional JVM/JAR sandbox bypass through unvalidated launcher tokens in java() command arguments

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x8q7-6c7m-52gw).

CVE-2026-128138 (official CVSS 9.8): Supplying -jar or an @argfile through nltk.internals.java or StanfordSegmenter.java_class can therefore execute attacker-selected Java bytecode without the unsafe-JAR opt-in. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: nltk 3.10.4.

## Guard Core: Quadratic ReDoS in built-in detection pattern freezes the event loop with a single request

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r7hm-rjvg-xx7j).

CVE-2026-129302 (official CVSS 7.5): From 3.5.0 until 3.13.0, built-in penetration-detection patterns in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py execute through a direct pattern.search(content) call instead of the timeout-protected create_safe_matcher() path used for custom patterns. The built-in template-injection detector contains an unbounded expression with quadratic behavior when scanning repeated opening braces.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: guard-core 3.13.0.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-129302 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-129302) |
| CVSS 7.5 | official | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-129302) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

## NLTK: Compile-time regex DoS in NLTK search/tokenizer sinks: quadratic regex-engine compile bypasses the match-only timeout

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-32p6-cwhc-8r78).

CVE-2026-129229 (official CVSS 7.5): The third-party regex engine compiles group-dense patterns with roughly quadratic cost before the match-time timeout begins, allowing a small unauthenticated request to exhaust CPU and deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: nltk 3.10.4.

## GitLab Critical Patch Release: 19.6.1, 19.5.8, 19.4.10

Source-reported by [GitLab Security Releases](https://docs.gitlab.com/releases/patches/patch-release-gitlab-19-6-1-released/).

CVE-2026-132825 (official CVSS 7.4): Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. One byte can be written outside a buffer for, for example, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: 19.6.1, 19.5.8, 19.4.10.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-132825 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-132825) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

## baserCMS: Path Traversal Bypass via realpath() in BcThemeFileService (CVE-2026-30940 Patch Bypass)

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2pj4-v76f-wjvx).

CVE-2026-62955 (official CVSS 7.2): An authenticated administrator can supply a traversal path through the theme-file API to access locations outside the theme directory. The bypass of the CVE-2026-30940 fix can permit file writes, overwrites or deletion within the PHP process permissions and, where executable PHP can be written, remote code execution.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: baserproject/baser-core 5.3.0.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-62955 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-62955) |
| CVSS 7.2 | official | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-62955) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.

## Flyto2 Core: SSRF guard bypass via DNS rebinding (validate_url_ssrf resolves-then-connects without pinning)

Source-reported by [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6pm8-6f34-9v3g).

CVE-2026-77316 (official CVSS 7.1): Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. Prior to 2.26.8, validate_url_ssrf() in src/core/utils.py validates one DNS answer and then returns the hostname, while guarded_aiohttp_request(), enforce_outbound_url(), and validate_url_with_env_config() allow the outbound connection to perform an independent second lookup.

**What to do:** Upgrade to a fixed release: flyto-core 2.26.8.

| Claim | Check | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CVE-2026-77316 exists | confirmed | [cve.org](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-77316) |
| CVSS 7.1 | official | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-77316) |

Identifiers and scores checked automatically against cve.org and NVD.

SecOpsAI detection: `secopsai supply-chain advisory-check --advisory GHSA-6pm8-6f34-9v3g PATH` flags flyto-core before 2.26.8 in a project's manifests and lockfiles.

**Limitations:** Source-reported; SecOpsAI did not reproduce the issue.
